assessments.reasoning: The first rule in section 2 defines a program as a single module. The translation-unit production includes optional directives followed by a sequence of global declarations and assertions.

challenge.method: Compare a program containing two function declarations with an application holding multiple GPUShaderModule API objects. Determine what the one-module count applies to.
challenge.results: The declarations can belong to one translation unit. The separate API defines module objects and their method-level creation. Its object count supplies no counterexample to the language-level count.

limitations: The rule does not determine entry-point count, application resource count, or the input/output relationship of external preprocessing.
